summary: @servicetitan/marketing-ui preinstall drops Bun runtime and executes obfuscated payload
details: package.json declares `scripts.preinstall: 'node setup.mjs'`. setup.mjs is obfuscated (hex-only `_0xXXXX` identifiers) and, on `npm install`, downloads the Bun runtime from github.com/oven-sh/bun releases into a temp directory, chmods it executable, and invokes it via `execFileSync` against the sibling file math_init.js. math_init.js is a 727KB blob obfuscated with the obfuscator.io string-array-rotation pattern (rotator function shifting a large numeric/string table, `// @bun @bun-cjs` header), invoked only through the downloaded Bun binary — a shape that evades Node-based static/AST scanners. The package publicly advertises itself as a React UI component library; there is no build/runtime reason for such a library to fetch an alternate JavaScript runtime at install time or to ship a large obfuscated payload executed under it. The combination of a lifecycle-triggered alternate-runtime dropper plus a heavily obfuscated payload delivered to installers and CI systems on `npm install` is install-time remote code execution on the installer's host.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
